label: The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle, sense-fixed
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.2 co., unattributed: the esse of every CREATURE_1 (whatever a cause of the being of every other being in act causes in its being, IsCreatureOfUniversalCause) is received in some principle. Sense-fixed sibling of 'The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle' (29e71e43-1d34-5008-8811-897fbddda209), which takes Creature as a parameter: same content at CREATURE_1, derived from it by instantiation (creature1EsseIsReceivedAtCreature1), but its Lean declaration names the CREATURE_1 constant, so it cannot be instantiated at CREATURE_2. The passage says it of a subsistent created form; the generalization to every CREATURE_1 is the analyst's. It does not say the principle is the thing's own essence.
